output.summary: A deciduous tree native to eastern North America and the tropical mountain regions of Mexico and Central America. It is easily remembered by its glossy, star-shaped leaves and hard, round, densely spiked fruits. The leaves often turn vivid yellow, orange, red and purple in autumn, though southern trees may show little colour.
output.edibilityNote: Gum resin exuded from wounded bark was used to make chewing gum.
